primary_citation.popular_name: Right of Petition, Assembly, and Public Access to Information

key_holding: The people have the right to petition, assemble, and access information about the conduct of the people's business. Statutes furthering access are broadly construed; statutes limiting access are narrowly construed. Constitutional foundation for the California Public Records Act and Brown Act.

amendment_history.event: Prop. 59 — added subdivision (b) creating constitutional right of access to government information, broad/narrow construction rules
Prop. 42 (Res.Ch. 123, 2013) — added paragraph (7) requiring local agencies to comply with PRA and Brown Act as constitutional mandate
